title: [CON-12] DM delivery uses "relay hints" from the recipient's DID document, which §2 forbids
description: Review finding CON-12: DM delivery uses "relay hints" from the recipient's DID document, which §2 forbids (lens CON). Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
